name: CTOS
recent: CTOS Digital 在2026年11月初遭遇网络安全事件后已全面恢复信用报告服务。公司同时公布2026年第三季度业绩，营收与净利均同比增长。近期有多家机构股东（EPF、KWAP、Aberdeen）的持股变动申报，以及集团首席财务官的买卖交易记录。
notable: 公司发生网络安全事件，随后全面恢复信用报告服务。
公布2026年第三季度业绩，营收同比增长10.8%，净利同比增长30.2%。
集团首席财务官Tan Ming Yew于11月5日至6日合计增持20万股，并于11月10日减持20万股。
risks: 网络安全事件可能带来额外成本，有新闻标题提及成本上升影响展望。
多家机构股东（EPF、KWAP、Aberdeen）近期出现持股变动申报，需留意后续变动。
集团首席财务官在增持后短期内减持20万股。
earnings: 2026年第三季度营收为8756.7万令吉，环比增长0.8%，同比增长10.8%；净利为2754.3万令吉，环比增长21.6%，同比增长30.2%；净利率为31.5%，高于上一季度的26.1%。

recent_en: CTOS Digital fully restored its credit reporting services after a cybersecurity incident in early November 2026. The company also reported 3Q2026 results with revenue and net profit growing year-on-year. There were recent shareholding change filings by institutional shareholders (EPF, KWAP, Aberdeen) and dealings by the Group Chief Financial Officer.
notable_en: The company experienced a cybersecurity incident and subsequently fully restored its credit reporting services.
Reported 3Q2026 results with revenue up 10.8% YoY and net profit up 30.2% YoY.
Group CFO Tan Ming Yew acquired a total of 200,000 shares on 5-6 November and disposed 200,000 shares on 10 November.
risks_en: The cybersecurity incident may bring additional costs; a news headline mentioned higher costs clouding the outlook.
Several institutional shareholders (EPF, KWAP, Aberdeen) recently filed shareholding changes; further changes should be monitored.
The Group CFO disposed 200,000 shares shortly after acquiring shares.
earnings_en: 3Q2026 revenue was MYR87.567 million, up 0.8% QoQ and 10.8% YoY; net profit was MYR27.543 million, up 21.6% QoQ and 30.2% YoY; net margin was 31.5%, higher than 26.1% in the previous quarter.
